definitions.explanation: A sharp blade used for shaving hair from the face or body. Can refer to traditional straight razors or modern safety razors.

examples.japanese: {電気|でんき}かみそり⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{剃|そ}る→剃る：00384_soru⟧。
examples.english: I shave with an electric razor.

examples.japanese: かみそり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{刃|は}→刃：09865_ha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{交換|こうかん}→交換：02746_koukan⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。

examples.english: I accidentally cut my hand with a razor.

notes:
WRITING:
Can be written as {剃刀|かみそり} in kanji, but hiragana かみそり is much more common in everyday use.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {電気|でんき}かみそり: electric razor/shaver
- かみそり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{刃|は}→刃：09865_ha⟧: razor blade
- かみそり⟦{負|ま}け→負け：02569_make⟧: razor burn (skin irritation from shaving)
- ⟦{使|つか}い{捨|す}て→使い捨て：07665_tsukaisute⟧かみそり: disposable razor
- かみそり⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{剃|そ}る→剃る：00384_soru⟧: to shave with a razor

SIMILAR WORDS:
- シェーバー: shaver (loanword, usually for electric razors)
- T⟦{字|じ}→字：01606_ji⟧かみそり: safety razor (T-shaped)

CULTURAL NOTE:
At Japanese ⟦{理髪店|りはつてん}→理髪店：06320_rihatsuten⟧ (barbershops), a straight razor shave ({顔剃|かおそ}り) is a standard part of the service. ⟦{床屋|とこや}→床屋：01682_tokoya⟧ (barbers) are licensed to use straight razors, whereas ⟦{美容室|びようしつ}→美容室：20238_biyoushitsu⟧ (beauty salons) traditionally are not.
